content:
Madhya Pradesh Employee Selection Board (MPESB) has released the Krashi Vistar Adhikari Admit Card 2026 for the Group-2 Sub Group-1 Agriculture Extension Officer examination. The written exam is scheduled for 17 September 2026.

Candidates can download their admit card from the official MPESB portal using registration details or the link provided in the Important Links section.
